messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Nadia Voss:

By late morning on Wednesday (12/13), I'll have this delivered without any problem. I just wanted to keep you informed.

Have a great day.
\-Mara

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks, Mara Ellison! I'll actually be OOO on Wednesday and Thursday. Do you think you can share your work in a Google Doc with elias@emberfield-studio.example and <http://elias.ward@emberfield-studio.example?|elias.ward@emberfield-studio.example?> They can review your work while I'm out and I can send the payment and feedback when I'm back in the office on Friday.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thanks for the direction—no problem. I’ll update the share settings to include those individuals. Have a good weekend!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi Nadia Voss:

I’m checking in because 10 days have passed since we spoke. Could you confirm that you received my deliverable?

Thanks, and have a great day!
-Mara

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi Mara!

I’ve now finished reviewing your article, and you did a great job—your writing is strong. To make the blog even better, though, please add more storytelling, such as engaging intros that break up the long informational lists. My team and I left our feedback directly in the article for you to review and use when making the relevant edits.

Once you’ve reviewed the feedback and completed those edits, we’ll be ready to pass your test article along to our client. I really appreciate your work on this and look forward to receiving the revised version.

Article with Emberfield Studio feedback: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CedarBrief4826MosaicDraft/edit#heading=h.reviewscope4826>

If you have any questions, let me know!

Thanks,
Nadia Voss

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Nadia Voss:
Thanks for getting back to me. I'll begin by reviewing the edits you provided; what deadline should I work toward for completing the updated draft?

\-Mara

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Having them by next Monday afternoon would be great. If that turnaround is too quick, though, having them by the following Friday is also fine.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, I'll see what I can pull together.
Before I proceed, I have one general question about the comments. The request for more content/words is fine, and I can handle it. I had originally kept the content very terse because I was trying to stay under the blog's 1800 words requirement. If going a little over is acceptable, I can definitely add more introductions where noted; I just want to confirm that the word count isn't a hard limit.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Your attention to detail here is appreciated, but the word limit is not a hard one!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Nadia Voss:
In the google doc you provided, I think I've addressed your comments. So that you can see my resolution, I kept the 4 comments open.
<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CedarBrief4826MosaicDraft/edit?usp=sharing>

Working on this project was fun, and I hope we can collaborate again soon!
\-Mara

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Your edits were exactly what we wanted, and the blog looks great! As our next step, we'll share your test article with our client. After they review and approve your work, I'll follow up with you about pay, timeframes, and a monthly copywriting cadence.

Talk soon!
Nadia Voss

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
That’s fantastic news, and I’m very glad to hear it. If your next update comes after the holiday season, I hope you and the team enjoy a good weekend and a restful holiday in the meantime. I look forward to hearing from you again soon.

—Mara

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Nadia Voss,

Before the year and holiday season wrap up, I wanted to check whether your client has shared any feedback on the test article I completed. I know the timing is tight at year-end, but I’m available to begin whenever you’re ready.

I hope you have a relaxing end to the year!

—Mara E.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Thanks for checking in, Mara, and I hope your holiday weekend was wonderful. Our client’s site has just launched, which is why the past 8 weeks have been so hectic. They still have not reviewed your work, but I’m hoping to receive their feedback by the middle of next month. As soon as I know more, I’ll follow up with you.

Happy New Year,
Nadia Voss

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
There’s great news, Mara: Redwood Coilworks has reviewed your work and would like to arrange a meeting with you. The call would let them learn more about your background while giving you context about their company and brand. Please tell me whether you’re available during the first half of next week.

You can review the team’s feedback and suggested edits to your test article here: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MarinerNotes7315WillowReview/edit?usp=sharing>. Let me know if anything raises questions.

In addition to arranging the meeting, my team wants to give you another copywriting assignment. Rather than writing a blog article this time, you’ll update the copy on an existing landing page at <http://redwood-coilworks.example|redwood-coilworks.example>. I plan to send the brief three business days from now. Regarding your rates, how many hours do you expect this copy-editing project to require?

Thanks!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Meeting with Redwood Coilworks would be great, Nadia Voss, and thank you for forwarding their feedback. I’m not sure which slots you have open, but my best morning availability is Monday through Thursday next week before 9am EST. For afternoons, I can do Monday/Thursday next week after 3pm EST. I’m already fairly booked tomorrow evening (Tuesday), so that period won’t work.

After I review the landing page, I’ll send you an estimate of the required hours tomorrow morning.

One question would help me plan: if the meeting with Redwood Coilworks goes well and they like what I can offer, how much total work do you anticipate for the broader project? The more I know about its likely volume, the better I can prioritize and schedule my time.

Thanks!
—Mara E.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
I’ll relay your available times and then send a Google Meets invitation. Which email address should I use for it?

Here is the specific existing landing page you’ll update: <https://redwood-coilworks.example/compression-springs>. As with the previous brief, we’ll include section-by-section instructions describing what we want to see.

Our current estimate is around 9 assignments per month, though that volume is not guaranteed. Because blogs are expected to require more time than copy-editing work, we may exchange 4 blogs for 8 copy-editing tasks as needed.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
For the meeting invitation, please use the dedicated address I keep for this kind of work: mara.ellison@harborquill.example

I also appreciate the workflow update—thanks!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Nadia Voss,

After reviewing the page, I think an approximate quote of 12 hours is reasonable for reworking its copy. I’m comfortable retaining the hourly rate previously quoted for the first article, $80/hr, along with the same 9 days of lead time. That lead-time period begins once I receive the contract and all materials required to start.

Please let me know whether those terms work for you. I’m available to begin whenever you need me to.

—Mara E.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: At the start of next week, I can send over a new milestone. The proposed terms sound good to me—thanks for the update! :)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The meeting invitation has just been sent, with the call scheduled for next Thursday at 4 pm ET!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The invitation came through, and I also received the google confirmation. I’ll be there at the scheduled time!
